executive_summary: Dr. Verghese Kurien writes an open letter to his grandson Siddharth, reflecting on his journey in Anand, Gujarat. He recounts how he transformed India from a milk-deficient nation into the world's largest milk producer through the Amul cooperative movement (Operation Flood), eliminating middleman exploitation and placing ownership in the hands of dairy farmers.
